scope: Lumped physical heat and damage with specified power inputs; fictional calibration, not a vehicle-engineering model.
checks: Healthy cooling reaches a stable working range; loss of radiator area/flow causes heat, leaks and gasket damage.
Oil starvation removes pressure, increases physical drag and seizes bearings without a blanket heat kill.
Clutch friction work produces heat, torque fade and wear; disengagement cools without repairing the plate.
A fuel cut cannot prevent wheel-driven overrev; component failures follow actual crank speed.
A stronger clutch can overload the original shaft and selected gear, while the other gears stay intact.
Brakes and tyres receive work per corner; unloaded corners stay cool and sustained abuse wears only loaded parts.
Damage-off preserves all irreversible condition and fluids even during overrev, heat and leaks.
Thermal results stay stable at120Hz and60Hz, including energy, fluids and component wear.
Selective repairs and fluid service preserve unrelated failures, fuel and NOS; warnings do not repeat each frame.
Old saves migrate, nested states deep-copy and individual gear/gasket damage survive repeated round trips.
